description: This file defines an asynchronous execution manager class for managing concurrent async tasks, including polling, resource management, and monitoring within the AgentField SDK. It includes classes for metrics, locks, and the main orchestrator with methods for submitting, monitoring, and cleaning up executions, as well as handling event streams and circuit breaker logic.

classes.name: LazyAsyncLock
classes.description: Deferred asyncio.Lock that instantiates once the event loop is running.

classes.name: LazySemaphore
classes.description: Deferred asyncio.Semaphore that instantiates within the active loop.

classes.name: ExecutionManagerMetrics
classes.description: Comprehensive metrics for the execution manager.

classes.name: AsyncExecutionManager
classes.description: Main class orchestrating concurrent async executions, polling, resource management, event handling, and metrics within the SDK.
